title: Minor Updates of 23.x
html:
Minor versions of OpenFront Update 0.23

For the latest information, visit Discord

Versions

v23.1

31 May 2025

  • Fix unable to join public game, minor meta tweaks

v23.2

1 June 2025

  • Slow down attacks
  • Make bots weaker
  • Increase defense
  • Fix Translations showing as untranslated keys
  • Cap lobby sizes at 150

Link to Github release

v23.3

1 June 2025

  • Slight nerf to gold production by large players
  • Speed boost for very large attacks
  • 5% speed buff for mountains
  • Defense post boost
  • Small trade ship spawn rate increase
  • Attack losses up 20% for all attacks
  • Small speed effect boost for defense posts
  • 20% population growth decrease for large players
  • Nerfed worker growth boost slightly
  • Nerfed troop/worker conversion rate

Link to Github release

  • Revert to v22 meta
